degenerateReason: aOptionalString is omitted when NULL, so an inner leaf is either set (== null is false) or missing (an error), and a missing level is an error too: no row can be allowed. The empty oracle still fails any translation that returns a row; relation/or/two-hops-null-literal-or-root-attribute carries the discriminating oracle.
trap: A two-valued IS NULL returns b1 (inner with a NULL leaf), the rows with a parent but no inner, and the parentless rows, all of which CEL denies.
